title: Professional Email Reactivation Renewals: Price Column by Billing Plan
content:
Billing desk schedule for the price column of a Professional Email reactivation renewal. The price column is read from the billing plan and the calendar months of the term on the subscription record, and the plan seat price of the reactivation renewal is the seat price in that column.

| Billing plan and term on record | Price column |
|---|---|
| annual billed monthly, a 12-month term billed monthly | annual-billed-monthly column |
| monthly, a term of one calendar month | month-to-month column, priced above the annual commitment |
| otherwise | annual-commitment column |

## Seat prices held for reactivation renewals (USD per seat per month)

| Product | Annual-commitment column | Annual-billed-monthly column | Month-to-month column |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | 1.99 | not offered | 2.49 |
| Harborline Mail Plus | 3.99 | not offered | 4.99 |
| Harborline Mail Pro | 5.99 | not offered | 7.49 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 6.00 | 6.30 | 7.20 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 12.50 | 13.13 | 15.00 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 22.00 | 23.10 | 26.40 |

Example (hypothetical): a Microsoft 365 Business Basic subscription on the annual-billed-monthly plan over a 12-month term reads the annual-billed-monthly column, 6.30; on the monthly plan over a one-month term it reads 7.20; on the annual prepaid plan it reads 6.00.
